$comment: Pinned sources of the runtime/qwentts-server-* packs (P6-E): qwentts.cpp (ServeurpersoCom, MIT; the GGML port of Qwen3-TTS 12 Hz) and its ggml fork submodule (the SNAKE and COL2IM_1D ops the codec needs).

build.ps1 downloads both archives once into %LOCALAPPDATA%/sigil-dev-cache/qwentts/archives/ (one request each, a few seconds apart), refuses them unless size and sha256 match, extracts them and overlays server/ (Sigil's sigil-tts-server target).

Upgrade: change both commits and archive pins together (the ggml commit is the submodule pointer of the qwentts.cpp commit: GET /repos/ServeurpersoCom/qwentts.cpp/contents/ggml?ref=<commit>), re-read src/tts-server.h and src/qwen.h (server/sigil-tts-server.cpp reuses the HTTP handlers and the qt_* ABI), bump shim_revision when server/ changes, and the catalog version in src-tauri/model-catalog/runtime-qwentts.json with it.
name: qwentts.cpp

cuda.$comment: The transcribe.cpp pin (native/engines/transcribe/UPSTREAM.json): Turing, Ampere, Ada and Blackwell as native code, compute_80 PTX for the driver to JIT anything in between or newer. CUDA 13 has no Maxwell, Pascal or Volta (the ORT CUDA 13 floor, ADR 0001).
